item.title: Package mathutils
item.description:
Build a mathutils package with three functions over integer slices:

Function Description
Max(nums []int) int maximum element
Min(nums []int) int minimum element
Sum(nums []int) int sum of elements

Each function returns 0 for an empty slice.

Edit mathutils/mathutils.go. Run check or go test ./... to verify.

item.title: Reverse a String
item.description:
Implement Reverse(s string) string — returns the string in reverse order.

Examples:

Reverse("hello") → "olleh"
Reverse("") → ""
Reverse("racecar") → "racecar"

Tests are in solution_test.go. Run check or go test to verify.

item.title: Hello, goalgo
item.description:
goalgo is a platform for practicing algorithms in the browser using a real terminal.

No setup, no local environment. Open a page, get a container running Go, solve a problem in vim.

Stack

  • Hugo — static site, GitHub Pages
  • Go / Chi — backend microservices
  • Docker — isolated exercise containers
  • xterm.js — browser terminal
  • vim — editor inside the container, pre-configured with vim-go and gopls

What's coming

  • More Go exercises
  • Python support
  • Blog posts on algorithms and Go internals

item.title: Multiplication Table
item.description:
Print a 5×5 multiplication table using nested loops.

Format: each line is A x B = C

Example output:

1 x 1 = 1
1 x 2 = 2
...
5 x 5 = 25

Run check in the terminal to verify your solution.

site-content

Публичный контент сайта goalgo — упражнения и блог в формате Hugo Markdown.

Структура 

content/
├── _index.md — главная страница
├── exercises/
│ ├── _index.md — страница раздела
│ └── go/
│ ├── _index.md
│ ├── go-expr-01.md — Multiplication Table (easy)
│ ├── go-func-01.md — Reverse String (easy)
│ └── go-multi-01.md — Package mathutils (medium)
└── blog/
 ├── _index.md
 └── hello-world.md

Добавление упражнения

  1. Создать content/exercises/{lang}/{id}.md
  2. Указать в front matter: pack, exercise, difficulty, tags
  3. Добавить шорткод {{< terminal pack="..." exercise="..." >}}
  4. Пуш в main → GitHub Actions пересобирает сайт

Связь с exercises репо

Упражнения на странице (условие, шорткод) живут здесь. Файлы задачи (workspace, check.sh) — в репозитории exercises.
